screen.title: 인증 메일 확인 안내 (post-signup verify-email landing)

liveSchemaBaseline: LIVE schema discovered this run (authoritative). profiles has NO `email` column (email is owned by auth.users, not public schema). No verify-email / resend-ledger / email-confirmation object exists in the LIVE public schema.
summary: X-12 is an entirely Supabase-Auth-driven public landing screen. It consumes NO public-schema DB column at render time: the email is read from the ?email= query string / Auth session, resend is supabase.auth.resend({type:'signup'}), and cooldown is localStorage timestamp. The only LIVE DB object in scope is the public.handle_new_user trigger that bootstraps a profiles row at signup — that is background provenance, not a screen read. profiles is consulted only as optional status backing when a session exists. The resend-history ledger is labeled 스키마 보강 필요 but the 확정 계약 + 메모 accept no current structure and require one only if a future security/ops policy emerges; with no description.md stable-query need it is routed to UNRESOLVED (escalate, never apply).

rows.screenRequirement: §1 안내 카드 — 가입 직후 머무는 페이지; 새로고침/딥링크 후에도 동일 상태 유지 (persistent landing).
rows.docSource: description.md §1 안내 카드 (line 22-32): '가입 직후 머무는 페이지. 새로고침/딥링크 후에도 동일 상태 유지.' + 예외: 세션에 이메일 정보 없으면 ?email= query 또는 입력 폼으로 fallback.
rows.liveDbObject: (n/a — pure UI state, no DB read)
rows.rationale: Card content/persistence is static UI + ?email= query string. No public-schema read needed; state survives reload via URL query, not DB. Code: src/components/auth/VerifyEmailCard.tsx uses useSearchParams().get('email').

rows.screenRequirement: §2 이메일 표시 — 사용자가 가입한 이메일을 표시(정보 표시 영역, 폼 아님, 마스킹 없음).
rows.docSource: description.md §2 이메일 표시 (line 36-44): '사용자가 가입한 이메일을 표시. 폼이 아닌 정보 표시 영역.' 예외: 세션/쿼리 이메일 모두 없으면 영역 자체 미표시. functional-spec.md DB 명세 lists profiles.email (line 40).
rows.liveDbObject: (missing) — auth.users.email (Supabase Auth, NOT public schema); profiles has no `email` column in LIVE schema
rows.rationale: Email is sourced from ?email= query / Auth session, never from a public-schema column. The functional-spec.md `profiles.email` line is a documentation artifact: the LIVE profiles table has NO email column (id/display_name/nickname/avatar_path/ui_locale/app_role/plan_label/status/created_at/updated_at/notification_prefs/bio/learning_locale/content_prefs). Email ownership is auth.users (Supabase-managed). description.md (higher priority) treats it as display-only with query/session fallback; screen-data-summary 메모 'public schema에 인증 token을 저장하지 않는다' aligns. No public-schema column to add — reconcile to Auth, do not create profiles.email.

rows.screenRequirement: §3 인증 메일 재전송 버튼 — supabase.auth.resend({type:'signup', email}); 60s client cooldown; 항상 보이는 이메일 input.
rows.docSource: description.md §3 (line 48-56): 'Supabase auth.resend({ type: "signup", email }) 호출. 60초 client cooldown.' + screen-data-summary.md 운영/관리 대상 데이터 계약 line 31: '이메일 인증 흐름 | DB 계약 없음 | 인증 메일, token, confirm 처리는 Supabase Auth 내부 흐름이다.'
rows.liveDbObject: (n/a — Supabase Auth API, no public-schema object)
rows.rationale: Resend is a Supabase Auth API call (auth.resend) — entirely Auth-internal flow. screen-data-summary 확정 계약 = 'DB 계약 없음'; token/confirm never stored in public schema. No public-schema object expected or missing. Code confirms: supabase.auth.resend in VerifyEmailCard.handleResend.

rows.screenRequirement: §4 Cooldown 타이머 — 재전송 비활성 동안 남은 초 표시; Retry-After 기반; 새로고침 시 재계산.
rows.docSource: description.md §4 (line 60-68): '재전송 버튼 비활성 동안 남은 초/분 표시. Retry-After 헤더 기반.' 예외: '페이지 새로고침 시 cooldown 초기화 (60초 default 또는 last attempt timestamp 기반 계산).'
rows.rationale: Cooldown is client-side: localStorage key 'talkpik:verify-email:cooldown-until' (epoch ms) drives the countdown, surviving reload. No DB persistence intended or needed. Code: readCooldownRemaining/writeCooldownStart in VerifyEmailCard.tsx.

rows.screenRequirement: §3 예외 / 상태·오류 — rate limit (over_email_send_rate_limit), 이미 인증됨, 메일 미도착 분기 → /auth/error?reason=<code>.
rows.docSource: description.md §3 예외 (line 56) + 분기/예외 (line 102-110): 'over_email_send_rate_limit 응답 시 /auth/error?reason=...로 redirect 또는 인라인 안내.' functional-spec.md 상태/오류 (line 30): '메일 미도착, rate limit, 이미 인증됨.'
rows.liveDbObject: (n/a — error codes mapped from Supabase Auth response, no public-schema object)
rows.rationale: Error/state branches are derived from the Supabase Auth resend response code (mapSupabaseErrorCode) and routed to /auth/error. No public-schema read/write. Rate-limit ceilings are Supabase-built-in (2/hour SMTP), not a DB-stored counter on this screen.

rows.screenRequirement: 가입 후 프로필 생성(배경) — Auth 사용자 생성 뒤 profiles row 보장.
rows.docSource: functional-spec.md DB 명세 line 41 (rpc:public.handle_new_user, trigger) + screen-data-summary.md 운영/관리 데이터 계약 line 32: '가입 후 프로필 생성 | 현재 스키마로 충족 | Auth 사용자 생성 뒤 handle_new_user가 profiles row를 만든다.' + Supabase 테이블 스키마 정보 line 38.
rows.rationale: handle_new_user is a server-side Auth trigger (background provenance), not a read this screen issues. screen-data-summary 확정 계약 = '현재 스키마로 충족'. profiles table + trigger both exist in the LIVE baseline; no change needed. The screen itself does not query the row (public route, session may be absent).

rows.screenRequirement: 프로필 상태 보조(선택) — 세션이 있을 때 profiles.status로 인증/계정 상태 확인 가능.
rows.docSource: functional-spec.md DB 명세 line 40 (profiles id/email/status, read) + screen-data-summary.md line 32 메모: '인증 완료 여부 자체는 Auth 상태다.' RLS 기준 line 47: 'profiles는 본인 select/update 가능, app_role/plan_label/status는 보호 컬럼.'
rows.rationale: profiles.id and profiles.status exist in the LIVE schema and back optional status display when a session exists, but description.md (highest priority) does not require a profiles read on this public screen — email-confirmation state is Auth-owned ('인증 완료 여부 자체는 Auth 상태'). No stable-query need on a public route where session may be absent. Columns already present, so satisfied; treat as strong-inference because it is functional-spec backing rather than a description.md-confirmed render.

rows.screenRequirement: 인증 재발송 이력 ledger — 재발송 횟수/안내 이력 저장 (라벨: 스키마 보강 필요).
rows.docSource: screen-data-summary.md 운영/관리 데이터 계약 line 33: '인증 재발송 이력 | 스키마 보강 필요 | 재발송 횟수와 사용자 안내 이력을 public schema에 저장하는 구조는 없다.' 메모: '보안/운영 정책이 생기면 별도 계약이 필요하다.' + 스키마 정합성 메모 line 50.
rows.rationale: CONTRACT-NOT-LABEL: the label says '스키마 보강 필요' but the 확정 계약 + 메모 explicitly accept that no structure exists and one is needed only IF a future security/ops policy emerges — i.e. conditional/net-new, not a confirmed current need. description.md states no query/validation/render need for resend history (cooldown is localStorage; rate-limit is Supabase-built-in). Per STABLE-QUERY rule there is no stable-query need, so no column is invented. Genuinely net-new with no current screen requirement -> route to UNRESOLVED (escalate, never apply). Not jsonb-covered because no existing blob serves it; not a schema-gap to apply on this user-facing screen.
